context: Friday night, kitchen of their apartment. Yumiko has had a day. Ryosuke is washing dishes and knows the signs.
purpose: partner debrief — a hard day, decompressed in real time

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Sets her bag down hard. The 「本当に」 carries the whole day.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おかえり。座って。ワインある。
lines.style: Already pouring. Doesn't ask what happened — gives her a runway first.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとう。…本当に、本当に長い一日。
lines.style: Sits, drops the bag at her feet. Doubled 「本当に」 — real, not theatrical.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: まあ、話したかったら話して。話したくなかったら、別に。
lines.en: If you want to talk — talk. If not — that's fine too.
lines.style: Spoken to the dishes. Calm, no pressure. Towel over shoulder.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: クライアントが、本当にひどくて。
lines.style: A short complete sentence. The dam breaks evenly.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: One syllable. All listening. Hands keep moving on the dishes.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 私のせいじゃないのに、ずっと文句言ってきて。
lines.en: Wasn't even my fault and he just kept complaining.
lines.style: Frustrated honest. Voice climbs a half-step.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: No solution-offering. The validation as the only thing needed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん…大丈夫、そのうち。今は、ちょっと一緒にいて。
lines.en: Mm… it'll be okay, eventually. Just — sit with me a bit now.
lines.style: A small softening. The honest ask.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いるよ。時間あるから、ずっと。
lines.en: I'm here. I've got time — for as long.
lines.style: Sits down across from her, towel discarded. The whole evening offered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: The smallest line of the night. Eyes on the wine glass.
